notes: Regression fixture modeled on 2026-08 audits in a Laravel events app. Blade's {{ }} echoes the raw translation string into a single-quoted JS argument inside an Alpine x-on:click attribute. The English confirm_hint string in lang/en/events.php contains an apostrophe ('You'll'), which closes the JS string early and breaks the click handler for every English-locale visitor. The fix is to escape the value for JS context, for example with Js::from() or the @js Blade directive, not to edit the copy.
